params.name: steps
params.meaning: total flow-matching denoise steps; on 14B split across the two experts
params.interactions: Lightning: 4 total (2+2) at cfg 1; community uses 8 (4+4) for better motion

params.name: split
params.meaning: where the high-noise expert hands over to the low-noise expert

official_reference_code.boundary: 0.875 (T2V) / 0.900 (I2V) of the noise timeline, not a step count

params.interactions: high: add_noise=enable, start_at_step=0, return_with_leftover_noise=enable; low: add_noise=disable, end_at_step=10000, return_with_leftover_noise=disable

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; both samplers get the same value in the templates
params.interactions: cfg must be 1.0 with Lightning/lightx2v LoRAs; too high -> oversaturation

params.name: shift
params.meaning: timestep/sigma shift of the flow schedule; higher spends more steps at high noise (layout), lower at detail
params.interactions: node default is 3.0 — never leave it at the default for Wan; Lightning author: 'Euler with shift = 5'

params.name: denoise
params.meaning: KSampler only; KSamplerAdvanced uses the step range instead

params.name: length
params.interactions: 81 @16 fps = 5 s; 121 @24 fps = 5 s; S2V chunk needs >= 73; longer than one pass = chunking (S2V/Animate extend) — not a single 161-frame latent

params.name: fps
params.meaning: the model's native rate; the container fps must match it
params.interactions: setting 24 on a 14B output does not add frames, it speeds the clip up

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: multiples of 16 (14B nodes step=16); the 5B latent node steps by 32
params.interactions: Fun models trained at 512/768/1024; off-native sizes work but are not what the model was trained on; Lightning slow-motion was resolution-dependent in one report (1280x720 normal, 832x480 slow)

params.name: seed
params.meaning: only the high-noise sampler's seed matters (it adds the noise); the low-noise sampler's seed is irrelevant

params.name: strength_model
params.interactions: community motion fix: 0.6-0.8 on high-noise, 1.0 on low, cfg 2-3.5 on high / 1 on low, 8 steps

rules.message: every 14B Wan 2.2 model decodes with wan_2.1_vae.safetensors (16-ch); wan2.2_vae.safetensors (48-ch) is for the 5B only — the #1 reported Wan 2.2 error ('expected input ... to have 36/48 channels')
the 5B models need wan2.2_vae.safetensors (48-channel, 16x); with the 2.1 VAE the latent shape is wrong
Wan text encoding is CLIPLoader with type 'wan' on umt5_xxl; any other type mis-encodes the prompt
the Wan text encoder is umt5_xxl (fp8 scaled or fp16)
a *_high_noise LoRA belongs on the high-noise model branch (and *_low_noise on the low): 'high noise and low noise models and LoRAs need to be used correspondingly'
a *_low_noise LoRA belongs on the low-noise model branch
the T2V Lightning LoRA on a non-T2V model: 'many key values don't match ... significant dynamic and quality loss' (the S2V template does it knowingly)
with a distilled 4-step LoRA every sampler runs at cfg 1.0 (the template's switch sets 1); cfg above 1 is the community motion-recovery trick only on a no-LoRA high-noise pass
distilled LoRAs are 4-step (community: up to 8); 20 steps under a Lightning LoRA wastes time and over-bakes
every Wan 2.2 recipe sets ModelSamplingSD3 shift 5-8 (official code 5-12); the node default 3.0 is wrong for Wan
Wan frame counts are 4n+1 (81 = 5 s @16 fps, 121 = 5 s @24 fps); 80 is not a legal length
Wan 14B conditioning nodes take width/height in multiples of 16
the 5B latent node (16x VAE) takes width/height in multiples of 32
not a size the 14B model was trained at (1280x720, 720x1280, 832x480, 480x832); it runs, but expect weaker results than at a native size
the 5B model's native sizes are 1280x704 and 704x1280
14B models generate at 16 fps; a different container fps changes playback speed, not smoothness
5B models generate at 24 fps

a 14B high/low pair runs as two chained KSamplerAdvanced: high (add_noise enable, start 0, end = split, return_with_leftover_noise enable) feeding low (add_noise disable, start = split, end 10000, return_with_leftover_noise disable), same steps/cfg on both, low's model chain reaching the low-noise loader
a high-noise model without its low-noise partner (or the reverse) is half a model: both experts are always loaded
WanVaceToVideo.trim_latent must feed TrimVideoLatent.trim_amount before VAEDecode, or the reference image's latent frames appear as noise at the start
S2V needs at least 73 frames per chunk (official code motion_frames = 73)
WanImageToVideo without start_image is a T2V graph with the wrong node: wire the image
Wan 2.2 I2V/FLF2V have no CLIP-vision in their config and the official templates load none; a clip_vision_output is a Wan 2.1 habit — remove it
the recipe's template needs a newer ComfyUI than the pinned image (Wan Animate 2: 0.36.0 > 0.35.0)

prompting.negative_default: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走
prompting.negative_gloss: vivid tones, overexposed, static, blurry details, subtitles, style, artwork, painting, picture, still, overall gray, worst/low quality, JPEG artifacts, ugly, incomplete, extra fingers, badly drawn hands/face, deformed, disfigured, malformed limbs, fused fingers, motionless picture, cluttered background, three legs, many people in background, walking backwards

positive.line: Rich, extended prompts: the publisher recommends prompt extension because detail 'effectively enrich[es] the details in the generated videos'
Structure that the official examples follow: subject + action + camera move + lighting/style, in English or Chinese
I2V: the image carries the subject; the prompt describes motion, camera and atmosphere
80-120 words; opening scene -> camera motion -> reveal/payoff
Camera vocabulary the model follows: pan left/right, tilt up/down, dolly in/out, orbital arc, crane up, tracking shot, slow zoom, handheld, static camera; pace: slow-motion, time-lapse
Animate prompts describe the character and background ('Character Description: ... Background description: ...')

hurts.line: too-short prompts: the model fills gaps with its own defaults
words implying stillness (the official negative bans 静态/静止)
very large motion under a Lightning LoRA: artifacts, reversed vehicle direction

pitfalls.symptom: 'expected input ... to have 36 channels, but got 32' / '48 channels, but got 16'
pitfalls.cause: wrong VAE for the model (2.2 VAE on a 14B, 2.1 VAE on the 5B) or an outdated ComfyUI / a conflicting custom node
resolution x frames too large for the card
pitfalls.fix: drop to 640x640 or 832x480, keep 81 frames, use fp8_scaled; 5B fits 8 GB with offloading; GGUF pairs for 12 GB
the 20-step no-LoRA recipe for the final; or LoRA 0.6-0.8 on high / 1.0 on low with cfg 2-3.5 on high, 8 steps; or the newer 250928 / V2.0 LoRAs

pitfalls.symptom: LoRA 'key values don't match' warnings, poor result
pitfalls.cause: LoRA on the wrong expert or the wrong task's LoRA
pitfalls.fix: high LoRA on the high branch, low on low; T2V LoRAs on T2V, I2V LoRAs on I2V/Fun/FLF2V

pitfalls.symptom: first frame brighter / 'overbaked'; contrast drifts on extensions
pitfalls.fix: S2V template hack: duplicate the first latent frame (LatentCut + LatentConcat) and drop it after decode

pitfalls.symptom: noise in the first VACE frames
pitfalls.cause: the reference image occupies leading latent frames
start_image not wired (5B template ships with LoadImage bypassed); t2v files used for i2v
pitfalls.fix: wire start_image; use the i2v model files
cfg <= 3.5-6 (per recipe), 1.0 under distilled LoRAs; the default negative already bans vivid/overexposed

pitfalls.symptom: Animate ignores the reference / wrong mode
pitfalls.cause: background_video + character_mask still connected in Move mode (bypass still passes them)
pitfalls.fix: disconnect them for Move; width/height multiples of 16

pitfalls.cause: docs drift (e.g. docs' I2V steps name the t2v files)
pitfalls.fix: the template JSON wins; this profile was built from the JSON
